tickerText: [TENNIS] WTA Hamburg wraps round of 16 on clay as Kalinina and Bondar advance into Thursday's quarterfinals • [SQUASH] World Junior Championships quarter-finals get underway in Niagara-on-the-Lake with top seeds Zakaria and Singh in action • [BADMINTON] PV Sindhu squanders four match points in China Open round-of-16 loss to Chen Yufei in Changzhou • [PICKLEBALL] Inaugural PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open kicks off at Sports Arina with Collin Johns and 659 players • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender São José main draw begins in Brazil as Calderano and Takahashi join the field

newsItems.title: Hamburg Quarterfinal Field Takes Shape
newsItems.excerpt: Anhelina Kalinina and Anna Bondar headline Wednesday's round-of-16 winners at the WTA Hamburg Ladies Open, setting up quarterfinal clashes on Thursday at Am Rothenbaum.

newsItems.title: Junior Squash Quarter-Finals Begin
newsItems.excerpt: Mohamad Zakaria and Anahat Singh lead the field into individual quarter-finals at Niagara-on-the-Lake after top seeds tumbled through the round of 16.

newsItems.title: Sindhu Falls to Chen at China Open
newsItems.excerpt: PV Sindhu lets a 21-16, 20-16 lead slip away, losing 18-21 in the decider to Chen Yufei in the China Open round of 16 in Changzhou.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open Underway
newsItems.excerpt: The inaugural PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open opens at Sports Arina with 659 players, headlined by Collin Johns and China's Long Yufei.
